The event involves Donald Trump and Tina Peters using the Oval Office to promote election conspiracy theories ahead of the midterms.

The Bright Side:
Public access to paper ballots and risk-limiting audits provide a transparent mechanism for verification.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
This is a WHO/WHAT error. They claim the system is the problem (WHAT) to target specific political opponents (WHO).

Social Physics Analysis:
By projecting corrupt motives onto the electoral process, they maintain a narrative of victimhood to justify their own power-seeking, ignoring the actual evidence of secure, paper-based systems.

The Trajectory: The Path of Reckoning.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Destruction. The divergence creates systemic instability.

The Unavoidable Truth: Colorado elections use paper ballots and are audited.

The Unavoidable Lie: Voting machines are programmed to change votes.
